Name: Boss Battles
Author: w8AwA8w
Description:
[size=6] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/2I77Sqj.png[/img]
[/size][size=3]Boss Battles is a mod which adds 7 boss fights including 11 new monsters. The mod also includes 8 hats which can be dropped by the monsters and a skippable intro cutscene for each boss fight. By default during boss fights staircases are disabled and time is stopped for a maximum of 3 minutes.

Trailer Video (Includes Spoliers!):
[youtube]5cepBldHMDk[/youtube]

List of Bosses: 

[spoiler]﻿Royal Slime: Found on floor 29/30, the Royal Slime bounces around while shooting slimy eggs at the player.
Drops - (25%) Slime Mask,  3 Copper Bars, 25 slime
This boss is designed to be beaten with a little bit of food and a level one sword.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]﻿Infected Golem: Found on floor 39/40, the infected golem phases in and out of battlefield when struck, swarming the player with golems and bats.
Drops - (25%) Gem Eyes, 5 Copper Bars
I recommend a level 3 weapon for this fight with some food, a glow ring helps too.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]﻿Dust Amalgamation: Found on floor 59/60, the dust amalgamation utilizes a holy blade to strike down the player for farming dust spirits.
Drops - (25%) Dust Helm, 3 Iron Bars, 13 coal, (10%) Holy Blade
A level 3-5 weapon with some food should be good for this fight as well. Speed buff food helps a lot.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]﻿Living Crystal: Found on floor 79/80, a crystal taken over by a ghost tries to haunt the player. Has a difference for big phase 2.
Drops - (25%) Wearable Crystal, (25%) Ghost Crown, 5 Iron Bars
This fight ramps up a nice bit near the end so save food, a level 5 or higher weapon is intended.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]﻿Sisters of Shadow: Found on floor 99/100, three shadow people with differing specializations attack the player.
Drops - (25%) Wise Sister's Mask, 5 Gold Bars
You'll want a level 7 weapon for this fight with nice food, some attacks can apply nausea so plan ahead.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]﻿Dwarven Soldier: Found on floor 119/120, a war borne Dwarf uses his hammer to trap, slam, and explode the player.
Drops - (25%) Dwarf Warrior's Helm, (5%) Dwarf Hammer, 2 Gold Bars, 2 Iron Bars, 2 Copper Bars
Fight was balanced around a level 7+ weapon, its lengthy and near the end nausea is applied. A good pickaxe helps a lot.
[/spoiler]
[spoiler]﻿Iridium Warrior: Found on floor 99 of the skull cavern, this crazed being wields an infinity blade with dangerous intent.
Drops - (25%) Iridium Mask, 5 Iridium Bars, Prismatic Shard
Balanced around late game items like dwarf, galaxy and infinity weapons.
[/spoiler]

Bosses can only be fought once per day. If any of the bosses seem too hard/ easy for a difficulty let me know and I might change them to be harder/easier.

Included in the configuration are options to change difficulty, re-enable the use of staircases on boss floors, guarantee the drop of cosmetics from bosses, change how much leeway time is given per day to fight bosses and disable boss health bars / titles.

This mod includes two i18n folders, if you translate the mod feel free to send it to me so I can add it to the mod :). 
Thanks to [url=http://]https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194119503-onebag132231/[/url] for translating the mod into Chinese!
Thanks to [url=http://]https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/61813001-pudinzinhaa/[/url] for translating the mod into Portuguese!

This mod hasn't been fully tested for multiplayer / split screen coop -  it should work fine but let me know of any bugs!
The health bars/titles don't always appear correctly on differing viewports, ui-scales and zoom levels. A fix will be worked on, but feel free to disable them if they cause issues. Harmony is used for the staircase prevention which can be disabled.

This mod was made as a submission for the SDV discord Halloween modding contest 2024
[/size]
